instructions.primary_message: Place spinach in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost. Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the spinach as you can, then place in a medium bowl.
Add ricotta, egg, garlic, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the spinach, then stir to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (425 g) pkg ricotta cheese
1 egg
1 tsp minced garlic
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear tortillas into 2-inch pieces.

Spread a ½-cup enchilada sauce on the bottom of a baking dish. Add ⅓ of the tortilla pieces and spread out in an even layer. Top with ⅓ of the ricotta mixture and ⅓ of the remaining enchilada sauce. Repeat layers twice more, ending with enchilada sauce, then evenly sprinkle with cheese.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (283 g) can red enchilada sauce
1 cup shredded cheese, Mexican blend

instructions.primary_message: Place casserole in the oven and bake until cheese is melted and filling is warmed through, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide enchilada casserole between plates or bowls and enjoy!
